## Wake Forest Demon Deacons vs. Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets: Full Highlights

* * *

By AP

Nov 21, 2026, 08:53 pm

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

ATLANTA -- — [Gio Lopez](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4920227/gio-lopez) completed 17 of 22 passes for 324 yards and accounted for four total touchdowns as No. 10 Wake Forest beat Georgia Tech 50-29 on Saturday afternoon.

The eighth consecutive victory for Wake Forest (10-1, 7-1 Atlantic Coast Conference, No. 11 CFP) extended the longest winning streak in program history, and clinched only the third double-digit win season in program history.
